# Biagio Cyberspace

> Personal blog of Biagio Scaglia — Full Stack Software Developer, UX/UI Designer, and creator of "Vellum - RPG Companion".

## About the Author

Biagio Scaglia is a Full Stack Software Developer and UX/UI Designer based in Bari, Italy. He specializes in React, TypeScript, .NET, and React Native. He is the designer and developer of "Vellum - RPG Companion", a mobile app for tabletop RPG players.

His interests include retrocomputing, video games (especially handheld consoles like the PS Vita), anime and manga, Internet culture, and the independent web movement.

## About This Site

Biagio Cyberspace is Biagio's personal blog, inspired by the aesthetics of the early-2000s web (GeoCities, Angelfire, personal homepages). The site is built with Astro, TypeScript, and SCSS, and is designed to evoke the charm of Windows 95/98-era interfaces while running on modern web technology.

The blog covers topics including:
- Software development (React, TypeScript, .NET, React Native)
- UX/UI design
- Retrocomputing and web history
- Video games and gaming culture
- Anime and manga reviews
- Internet culture and the independent web

- [Welcome to Biagio Cyberspace](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/welcome-to-biagio-cyberspace/): Introduction to the blog and its author

- [How Welcome to the NHK Changed My Life](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/nhk-changed-my-life/): Personal essay on the anime NHK ni Youkoso
- [Biagio Cyberspace: How I Rebuilt the 2003 Web in 2026](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/astro-net-retro/): Technical deep-dive on building a retro-styled site with modern tools
- [Anemoia: Nostalgia for a Cyber-Past We Never Lived](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/anemoia-nostalgia-for-a-lost-cyberspace/): An exploration of anemoia — the longing for a past you've never personally experienced — and why the early 2000s web feels like home.
- [Touhou Scarlet Curiosity Review](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/touhou-scarlet-curiosity-review/): Personal review of the action-RPG Touhou Scarlet Curiosity on the Nintendo Switch.
- [No More What Ifs: The Melancholic Jazz of Persona 5 Royal](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/no-more-what-ifs-persona-5/): Reflection on the calming, beautiful jazz track from Persona 5 Royal playing at the Jazz Jin in Kichijoji.
- [OS-Tans: When the Internet Turned Operating Systems into Anime Mascots](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/os-tans-and-the-glory-of-windows-2000/): A nostalgic look at the 2chan/Futaba Channel OS-tan phenomenon and Windows 2000 Pro (2K-tan).
- [Beyond the Screen: Building a Retro Windows XP Visual Novel with Zero AI](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/beyond-the-screen-retro-visual-novel/): A deep-dive into building Oltre lo Schermo, an indie retro visual novel exploring isolation and mental health, built with Ren'Py.
- [Exiting the Shell: A Melancholy Journey to Nuremberg](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/first-time-leaving-italy-nuremberg/): Reflection on overcoming travel anxiety, leaving Italy for the first time, and facing social anxiety with the support of a trusted friend.
- [Broken Circuits and Unstable Sleep Cycles: The Webmaster's Night Log](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/broken-circuits-and-unstable-sleep-cycles/): An introspective reflection on chronic insomnia, racing thoughts, and the unstable equilibrium of sleeping too little or sleeping too much in the life of a software developer.
- [Midnight Tides and Temperature Shocks: A Night at the Beach](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/midnight-tides-and-temperature-shocks/): A personal reflection on spending a beautiful night at the beach on August 2nd—starry skies, a midnight swim, the biting cold of the sea breeze, and the harsh morning heat.
- [Compiling Sanity: When Code is the Only Escape](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/compiling-sanity-when-code-is-the-only-distraction/): A deeply personal reflection on going through a rough patch, dealing with racing thoughts, and how programming and web development have become the only distraction that keeps my mind anchored.
- [Moon Inferno: My Custom React UI Framework is Online!](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/moon-inferno-react-framework-is-online/): Announcing Moon-Inferno, an accessibility-first React UI framework and design system built for retro, Y2K, CRT, cyberpunk, and pixel art web applications. Exploring the GitHub repository and live demo.
- [The Urge to Build: Moon Inferno's Spark and Impostor Shadows](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/missed-code-moon-inferno-success-and-impostor-syndrome/): A personal reflection on the unexpected success of Moon-Inferno, having too many ideas, missing coding during vacation, and dealing with impostor syndrome regarding the main day job.
- [Reconnecting Offline: Lecce, Archery, and a 2km Sea Crossing](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/reconnecting-travels-archery-and-2km-swims/): A personal reflection on stepping away from the IDE to travel across Puglia—visiting friends in Lecce and Foggia, discovering an unexpected skill in archery, and swimming 2km to a small island.
- [HomuraJS: Rewriting Timelines with a DAG State Engine](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/homurajs-time-travel-dag-state-engine-released/): Announcing HomuraJS, a non-destructive time-travel state engine modeled as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for JavaScript, React, and WordPress.
- [Yumia-MD: Presentations as Code — PPTX, PDF & HTML from One Source](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/yumia-md-programming-language-for-visual-documents/): Announcing Yumia-MD, an open-source design compiler that turns semantic slide intent into editable PowerPoint, vector PDF, and interactive HTML.
- [KawaiJS: A Web-Native Visual Novel Engine Inspired by Ren'Py](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/kawaijs-web-native-visual-novel-engine/): Announcing KawaiJS, a browser visual novel engine with Ren'Py-style .kawa scripting, CSS UI, save/load, backlog, VFX, and static exports.
- [Sorry for the Silence — Work Has Been Eating Me Alive](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/sorry-for-the-silence-work-has-been-eating-me/): Apology for the blog going quiet because the day job has been extremely stressful.
- [Frutiger-JS Hit 10 GitHub Stars… and I Completely Missed It](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/frutiger-js-hit-ten-stars-and-i-missed-it/): Surprised thank-you after frutiger-js quietly reached 10 GitHub stars.
- [Work Is Consuming Me — But We Are Still Standing](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/work-is-consuming-me-but-we-are-still-standing/): Personal log about burnout and persistence — the webmaster and Biagio Cyberspace are still online.
- [Retroid Pocket Nova Review: 4:3 AMOLED Glory for Retro Emulation](https://biagiocyberspace.it/blog/retroid-pocket-nova-review/): Hands-on review of the Retroid Pocket Nova compact 4:3 120Hz AMOLED Android handheld.


## Projects

- **HomuraJS**: A non-destructive time-travel state and Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) history engine for JavaScript, React, Vue, and WordPress. Features copy-on-write proxy branching, structural diffing, and automated form recovery. Live at https://biagio-scaglia.github.io/homura-js/ | GitHub: https://github.com/biagio-scaglia/homura-js | NPM: `@biagioscaglia/homurajs` | WordPress: https://wordpress.org/plugins/homura-time-travel-form-recovery/
- **Moon-Inferno**: An accessibility-first (WCAG 2.1 AA) React UI framework and design system built for retro, Y2K, CRT, cyberpunk, and pixel art applications. Live at https://biagio-scaglia.github.io/moon-inferno/ | GitHub: https://github.com/biagio-scaglia/moon-inferno
- **Yumia-MD**: A programming language / design compiler for visual documents. Write semantic presentations once; export editable PPTX, vector PDF, and interactive HTML. Docs: https://biagio-scaglia.github.io/Yumia-MD/ | GitHub: https://github.com/biagio-scaglia/Yumia-MD | NPM: `yumiamd`
- **KawaiJS**: A web-native visual novel engine inspired by Ren'Py, with .kawa scripting, CSS-skinned UI, save/load, backlog, and static HTML5 exports. Live at https://biagio-scaglia.github.io/KawaiJS/ | GitHub: https://github.com/biagio-scaglia/KawaiJS | NPM: `kawaijs`
- **Frutiger-JS**: A custom CSS framework for Frutiger Aero nostalgia — glossy gradients, sky-glass UI vibes, and late-2000s aesthetic styling. GitHub: https://github.com/biagio-scaglia/frutiger-js
- **Vellum - RPG Companion**: A mobile application designed for tabletop RPG players, serving as a digital character sheet and campaign management tool. Built with React Native.

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, React Native
- **Backend**: .NET
- **Blog Engine**: Astro (static site generator)
- **Styling**: SCSS with Windows 95/98-inspired design system
